name: Get-PrintJob
title: Inspect Jobs in a Windows Print Queue
summary: Lists documents currently held in a selected printer queue.

examples.command: Get-PrintJob -PrinterName 'Office Printer' | Select-Object ID, DocumentName, JobStatus, SubmittedTime
examples.description: Shows queued jobs for the named printer without removing them.

permissions.notes: Viewing another user's jobs or a remote queue may require additional rights.

risk.warning: Document names may contain sensitive information; review output before sharing.

output_fields.name: DocumentName
output_fields.description: Name Windows reports for the queued document.

output_fields.name: SubmittedTime
output_fields.description: When the job entered the queue.

common_errors.meaning: The printer name is incorrect or its queue is empty.
